steps.name: setup
steps.instruction: Place two flasks on the desk — one GREEN, one YELLOW.

steps.name: bring_baking_soda
steps.instruction: Bring the baking soda (yellow box) to the desk.

steps.name: pour_baking_soda
steps.instruction: Pour baking soda into the GREEN flask.
steps.detect: the yellow box is near, above, over, or close to the green flask
errors: yellow box is near the YELLOW flask instead

steps.name: remove_baking_soda
steps.instruction: Remove the baking soda box from the desk.
steps.detect: no yellow cardboard box is visible (yellow flask does NOT count as the box)
errors: yellow cardboard box still on desk

steps.name: pour_vinegar
steps.instruction: Pour vinegar into the YELLOW flask.
steps.detect: a bottle is near, above, over, or close to the yellow flask
errors: bottle is near the GREEN flask instead

steps.name: observe_reaction
steps.instruction: Pour green flask into yellow flask. Watch for fizzing!
steps.detect: green flask is near, above, or over the yellow flask, OR fizzing is visible
